notes.title: Nintendo Switch Physical Version will be available in Japan
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/0cbb2094edd2b4f599d996b792f2f641298ff221.png

We’re sorry, but this news is exclusive to Japan. However, we’re excited to announce that a special edition will be available! If you’re interested, you can import it from Japan using a forwarding service. The release date is April 24th, so please make sure the forwarding service you choose supports pre-ordered items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421433/aec1ab76fc024b9051324b880b286fd90452f0c6.jpg

Here is a link on Amazon.co.jp
https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0DNFJW2TX

Have a good day!

notes.title: Adjustment of lines, minor bug fixes, and Direct11 support.
notes.notes:
I thought there were no bugs or issues, but of course, that was not the case...
We have made adjustments to some lines and fixed minor bugs.
Also, we have added support for Direct11, which may reduce issues with capturing in OBS. If you encounter any problems while playing or streaming, please let us know.

notes.title: Major update for the Demo version!
notes.notes:
We've updated the demo version of "Meg's Monster"! New battle effects, a new tutorial battle, and brand new voice sound for all the characters! Even if you've already played the demo, check it out today!
